about: Hand-curated building detail, keyed by OSM id (way or relation). Prefer fixing OSM itself; put here only what OSM can't express or gets visibly wrong, with a source. Fields: height, min_height, roof_shape, roof_height, wall_colour, roof_colour, material (wall|tenement|classic|glass|solid), drop. `add` lists parts OSM doesn't map at all, as circles (lon, lat, radius m). Landmarks drawn in detail are in scripts/landmarks.py.

6486918.name: Budavári Palota
6486918.source: photos: grey-green patinated roofs, pale limestone walls; aerial photos: hipped copper roofs over every wing, about 22 m to the eaves over the Lions' Court

12944.name: Anker-ház
12944.source: photos from Deák tér (Mapillary 2024): ochre-yellow stone, 1908-10, Ignác Alpár; the cornice about 28 m up (six tall storeys over the shops and a mezzanine), where the levels gave 20 m

239339482.name: Vörösmarty n°1
239339482.source: photos from the square (Mapillary 2025): pale sky-blue reflective glass; the glass material's dark default read near black

add.name: Anker-ház tower 1
